data.name: Panda, Please!
data.detailed_description:
She is not cargo. She is a panda.


Bao Bao needs to get from her enclosure to the pickup truck waiting at the end of the trail. That is the whole job. Bao Bao does not know this, does not care, and has plans of her own: bamboo, a nap in the grass, and the occasional urge to roll down a hill for no reason at all.

You and up to three friends are the people who have to move her anyway.

A heavy, soft, opinionated ragdoll


Bao Bao is a full physics character, not a crate with fur. She breathes while she sleeps, wanders off toward things she likes, sits down to eat, and cannot be budged while she is chewing. She never helps you and never sabotages you on purpose — she simply wants what she wants, and your route is not her problem.

Clumsy hands, honest physics


Every player controls a wobbly little human with independent left and right hands. Grab, climb, lift, throw — including throwing each other. Nothing is scripted: a plan that works is a plan you invented, and a plan that fails turns into a story instead of a game over screen.

1–4 players


Play solo or bring a crew of up to four in online co-op. One player hosts, friends join through Steam. In the full game every delivery is its own level, with its own route, obstacles and one very unbothered panda in the middle of it.

data.short_description: A physics comedy for 1–4 players about delivering one extremely uncooperative panda. Drag her, lift her, build her a bridge, improvise all the way to the pickup truck — while Bao Bao eats bamboo, takes a nap and rolls back downhill, blissfully unaware that anyone had a plan.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 570 (Vulkan 1.1 required)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Online co-op requires a Steam account and an internet connection

  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Online co-op requires a Steam account and an internet connection
